scripts.dev: PORT=3001 npm run dev --workspace=@workspace/api-server & npm run dev --workspace=@workspace/brightline-dental
scripts.build: rm -rf dist artifacts/brightline-dental/dist && npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspaces --if-present && mkdir -p dist && cp -r artifacts/brightline-dental/dist/* dist/ && touch dist/.nojekyll
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
